title: Global antimicrobial resistance—The ostrich’s head is in the sand
content:
by Susanna J. Dunachie, Mariagrazia Pizza

Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a growing problem that should be ignored at our peril. The development of new diagnostics, drugs, and vaccines to tackle AMR faces technical difficulties and challenges that need to be addressed urgently. Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a growing problem, ignored at our peril. This Perspective outlines the technical difficulties and challenges raised by the lack of market incentives for new diagnostics, drugs and vaccines to tackle AMR, and discusses potential solutions.
author: Susanna J. Dunachie
